title: Calling instance members from a static method
answer: A static method has no implicit `this` reference, so it cannot directly access a non-static field or call a non-static method as though an instance already existed. It can access instance members through an explicit object reference. This is because instance state belongs to a particular object, while static execution belongs to the class context. AeroTopo's static methods avoid direct use of the instance field `accepted`.
